content.label: Every parent asks
content.question: Will you focus on studies so far away?

answers.title: Fixed routine
answers.detail: Set times for classes, study and rest. Start from the very first week.

answers.title: Make a study group
answers.detail: Studying with classmates keeps the motivation going.

answers.title: Weekly update
answers.detail: Tell family every week what you studied and what's going on. It builds trust.
